dedupe_keys.name: matched swot river nodes and usgs stations near dam locations throughout conus

description: Matched SWOT River Nodes and USGS Stations Near Dam Locations throughout CONUS is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Anika Islam, Peyman Abbaszadeh (Portland State University). This dataset contains 269 matched locations across the Contiguous United States where there is a Surface Water and Ocean Topography (SWOT) satellite river node and a USGS monitoring station located in close proximity to a dam location. The dataset was developed to support machine-learning-based prediction of Water Surface Elevation (WSE) data at ungaged dam sites. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
